name: custom-auth
description: Generic provider for user-configured HTTP AI endpoints (IR <-> vendor wire via translator submodules), key via basekit/auth.
author: intisy

scripts.build: npm run emit:teavm && npm run build:teavm && npx esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/basekit --external:@intisy-ai/basekit/auth --external:@intisy-ai/basekit/ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/index.js && npx esbuild src/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/basekit --external:@intisy-ai/basekit/auth --external:@intisy-ai/basekit/ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/handler.js && npx esbuild src/driver.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/basekit --external:@intisy-ai/basekit/auth --external:@intisy-ai/basekit/ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/driver.js && npx esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@intisy-ai/basekit --external:@intisy-ai/basekit/auth --external:@intisy-ai/basekit/ir --external:sync-bridge --outfile=dist/plugin.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && vitest run
